title: Tree Service Estimate Template
subtitle: An estimate pre-filled for tree work — removal, stump grinding, trimming, pruning, storm cleanup and debris hauling. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Estimate valid for 30 days. A 25% deposit secures the job; balance due on completion.
notes: This is an estimate, not a final invoice. Final charges may vary based on site conditions and additional work approved on site.
features: Auto-calculating totals and 25% deposit in Excel
Pre-filled tree service line items: removal, stump grinding, trimming, pruning, storm cleanup, hauling
Valid-until date + deposit section standard for tree work quotes
License # field — many states require an arborist/contractor license on client-facing estimates

faqs.q: What should I include on a tree service estimate?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number, the client and job-site address, a dated line-item list (removal, stump grinding, trimming, debris), a validity date, deposit terms, and exclusions. Note that the estimate is not a final invoice.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate the deposit automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantities and rates, and the subtotal, 25% deposit and balance due update automatically.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your contractor board and a CPA or attorney before use.
